propositions: A deterministic baseline eval harness under tests/external/ must measure before/after raw-output distributions across provider-model cells (anthropic, bedrock, openai) under current vs sentinel directives by running n=10 production-shaped prompts and capturing layout-class rates and parse success.
The sentinel directive changes model output layout to 100% prose for anthropic/bedrock (fenced/multi_object → 0) and raises parse success rates on all arms, confirming the epic thesis.

A workflow_dispatch-only job in .github/workflows/ must run the harness with per-provider secret scoping, enforce a predeclared call-budget cap (default 300), record missing-credential cells as 'unmeasured' without failing, and upload raw replies + score_table.json as artifacts.

Unit tests must verify scorer correctness on committed E2 fixture goldens (exact counts), missing-credential skip logic, call-budget enforcement, and workflow registration without mocking the live boundary.
